blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Abbotsford East rose from 161 in June to 165 in September, and 107 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 37.5% of Abbotsford’s 440 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Abbotsford East?
Abbotsford East also had 69 condos and townhomes listed and 4 sold in September, against 165 houses listed. The Abbotsford East condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Abbotsford East?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 165 houses listed in Abbotsford East. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Abbotsford East a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Abbotsford East had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Abbotsford East from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 107 houses sold in Abbotsford East over those 4 months, out of 215 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Abbotsford East?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
